key_interactions.effect: Additive blood-pressure lowering and symptomatic hypotension (label).
key_interactions.action: Start the PDE-5 inhibitor at the lowest dose; monitor.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole, ritonavir, voriconazole)
